title: NIPER Raebareli Notification 2026 - Apply for Junior Research Assistant Posts
description: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli (NIPER Raebareli) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 01 Junior Research Assistant position. Candidates who have qualified for B.E/ B.Tech, M.Pharm, M.Sc., M.V.Sc., or any degree can use this opportunity and apply for the NIPER Raebareli Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts...
